title: Agent access
goal: Agents and clients reach the engine only through the SIANN protocol and an MCP adapter, building sessions through reviewed plans with rollback and audition.
done: WebSocket/HTTP protocol server with token handshake (#38)
Plans in the engine: per-entity staleness, approval, partial approval (#40)
prerequisites: M2 merged, or at least m2-playback-engine and m2-meters (the meter page needs the protocol).

features.title: WebSocket/HTTP protocol server with token handshake
acceptance: IXWebSocket (pinned, behind a thin adapter) serves 127.0.0.1 with a random per-launch token sent in the first message; no request is accepted before it.
Origin checks use an explicit allow list including the app scheme.
Every request carries sessionId and an idempotency requestId and gets exactly one response with a stable error code; a duplicate requestId returns the original response.

features.title: Events, gap detection and session.sync
acceptance: Events carry a monotonically increasing sequence and the revision; a client that detects a gap calls session.sync and continues from a full read model.
session.changed carries changed IDs; large sessions sync in chunks.
Meters and playhead go as binary latest-wins frames on a separate channel and never queue behind commands.
The protocol exposes the running build's source location and commit (AGPL section 13, ADR-0017).

features.title: Plans in the engine: per-entity staleness, approval, partial approval
acceptance: Plans carry readSet and writeSet with entity hashes; a plan stays valid while those entities are unchanged; approval returns plan_stale with the changed entities otherwise.
Partial approval produces a new sub-plan with a new hash, revalidated; the original is marked rejected.
planHash follows the shared JCS rules and matches the Node bridge for shared fixtures.

features.title: Rollback of applied plans
acceptance: Rolling back an applied plan creates an inverse revision when its entities are unchanged since, and returns rollback_conflict listing the entities otherwise.
External side effects (media, renders) are never deleted by rollback.

features.title: Proposal branches and A/B audition
acceptance: A proposal is a DAG branch; committing merges it into main, discarding leaves it unreachable but journaled.
Auditioning switches the live graph with duck-and-swap; only the live graph exists; a memory/CPU budget refusal returns a reason.

features.title: MCP adapter
acceptance: MCP tools map onto the command registry: list_commands, describe_capabilities, inspect_session, submit_plan, plan_status, approve_plan (trusted scope only), execute (trusted only), job_status, render, open/save session.
MCP clients default to the propose scope.
An end-to-end test drives the MCP adapter to build a session through approved plans, roll back and audition a branch.

exit.text: An MCP client builds a session through approved plans, rolls back and auditions a branch.
Reconnect and gap sync are tested.
exit.how: Protocol tests that drop events and reconnect.
